Ch130 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 130)

Subject: quantum error correction | ID: 1004

Statement

For any Markovian scheme f on a topological space X, the set of regular values is of full measure in the target space by Sard's theorem.

Proof

Step 1. The Holder operator \(V_{01300011}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle V_{01300011} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 2. The diagonalizable operator \(V_{01300012}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle V_{01300012} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. By the orthogonal spectral theorem, we decompose \(R_{01300013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the orthogonal spectral family.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via Wavelet interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01300011 \cdot C_01300012 \cdot C_01300013\).
